Tim Cook recently announced he’d be resigning as Apple’s CEO, with John Ternus, currently Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering, taking his place in September. Thinking back to 2011, when Cook initially became CEO, it’s hard to believe just how much Apple has changed.

Tim Cook didn’t throw out Steve Jobs’ playbook and turn Apple into a completely different company. What he did instead was optimize their existing strengths. Like great design, seamless hardware and software integration, and convenient services. While utilizing new financial strategies to transform Apple into a company twenty-times the size.
title: How Tim Cook Transformed Apple
